docs.intro: Every document number the factory gives, per company: the next one as it will print, and proof that invoices and DDTs never skip or repeat a number.
docs.later: E-mail and label templates, branding and the documents a record must have come in later steps.

issue.tooLong: A pattern has at most 40 characters.
issue.noNumber: The pattern needs the place of the number: {N}.
issue.twoNumbers: The number may appear only once.
issue.badText: Fixed text may hold letters, digits and - / . _ only.
issue.yearNeedsYearly: The year fits only a series that starts again every year.
issue.fiscalTooLong: An invoice or DDT number has at most 20 characters: shorten the pattern.

fiscal.title: Fiscal check
fiscal.intro: Invoices, deposit invoices, credit notes and DDTs must never skip or reuse a number (DPR 633/72 art. 21). Each line is read from the numbers actually issued.
fiscal.noSeries: No active fiscal series for this company yet.
fiscal.failed: The numbers could not be read.
fiscal.skipped: {count} issued, {first} to {last}; not issued by Nexus: {ranges}.

empty.title: No number series yet
empty.body: Number series are created with the company. If one is missing, add it with New series.

layouts.noRightTitle: Document previews are not yours to open
layouts.noRight: You need the right to preview the company's document layouts. Ask an administrator.
layouts.noCompany: Add a company first: its documents carry its legal data.
layouts.with: With the data of {name}: each preview opens as a PDF in a new tab, marked as a sample.
layouts.label: Document layouts
layouts.notReady_one: {name} cannot print documents yet: 1 legal fact is missing (registered office, VAT number, codice fiscale, REA office and number).
layouts.notReady_other: {name} cannot print documents yet: {count} legal facts are missing (registered office, VAT number, codice fiscale, REA office and number).
layouts.heldLegal: Complete the company's legal data first
layouts.fixed: Fixed layout: editing it comes later.

newDialog.title: New number series
newDialog.subtitle: Build the number from chips; the first number shows as it will print.
newDialog.fiscal: A fiscal series never skips or reuses a number, and numbers go out in date order. Its start and pattern are fixed once the first number is issued.

field.codeHint: MAIN for the usual series; another code (B, EXPORT) for a second series of the same document.
field.yearHint: The year of its first numbers.
field.startHint: 1, or where a paper booklet or the old program stopped, plus one.
field.typedHint: Fixed text and {N} (the number), {N:5} (5 digits), {YYYY} or {YY} (the year).

form.code: Use 1 to 16 capital letters, digits or hyphens.

held.manage: Needs the right: Manage number series

seriesDialog.title: Number series: {kind} {period}
seriesDialog.fiscal: Fiscal: never skips or reuses a number
seriesDialog.fiscalBody: Numbers go out in date order and a fiscal number has at most 20 characters. The database refuses any change to a number already issued.
seriesDialog.notFiscal: Not fiscal: the same gap-free rule applies, without the date order.
seriesDialog.fixed_one: 1 number issued: its start and pattern are fixed.
seriesDialog.fixed_other: {count} numbers issued: its start and pattern are fixed.

start.title: First number
start.body: Nothing was issued from this series yet, so its first number can still change once.

advance.title: After a restore: move past a number
advance.body: If numbers after {next} were already used elsewhere (the SDI receipts, the DDT archive), the series continues after the last of them. It never moves back.
advance.pastHint: The series continues with the next one.
advance.dateHint: Keeps the date order of fiscal numbers.
advance.heldReason: Say why, in a few words

close.title: Close series {name}?
close.noMore: No more numbers come from it.
close.stay: The numbers it issued stay, with their documents.
close.final: A closed series is not opened again: new documents need another active series.
close.alone: This company has no other active {kind} series: new documents of this kind will be refused until you add one.

numbers.title: Numbers issued: {kind} {period}
numbers.empty: The first document of this kind will take the first number.
numbers.label: Numbers issued, newest first
numbers.skippedBody: These numbers lie between the first and the last and were never issued here: the series was moved past numbers used elsewhere, or numbers are missing. The audit log says which.

done.created: Series created. Its first number is {number}.
done.closed: Series {code} closed: it issues no more numbers.

problem.conflict: Someone changed this series meanwhile. The list was read again: check it and try once more.
problem.invalid: The server refused it: check the pattern, the year and the first number.

bulk.none: None of the selected series is active: nothing to close.
bulk.noMore: No more numbers come from them.
bulk.stay: The numbers they issued stay, with their documents.

left.closed_one: 1 selected series is closed already: left out.
left.closed_other: {count} selected series are closed already: left out.

bulk.alone: {company} would have no active {kind} series left: new documents of this kind will be refused until you add one.
bulk.reasonHint: Kept in the history of each series.
bulk.done_one: 1 series closed: it issues no more numbers.
bulk.done_other: {count} series closed: they issue no more numbers.
bulk.failed_other: None of the {count} series was closed:
